title: The text provides a glimpse into the current state of Makerere University in Uganda, highlighting the challenges faced by students during a short vacation period. Many students remain on campus due to financial constraints or unsafe home environments. The demand for books has surged, but the library and bookshops are poorly stocked, forcing students to rely on old notes or buy books at inflated prices. Living conditions are tough, with overcrowded dorms and limited access to basic amenities like water and electricity. Despite these hardships, students find ways to support themselves through small businesses. The social divide on campus is evident, with wealthier students enjoying a more vibrant social life. The university's facilities have deteriorated, and funding issues have impacted events and maintenance. Overall, Makerere University reflects the broader economic struggles of Uganda while also showing signs of resilience and recovery.
